text: UPCOMING BRIDES!!!! If you’re looking for a live painter, Heather is absolutely the one you need!!!! She is incredibly talented and the SWEETEST person ever. Our guests kept coming up to me all night, raving about how stunning her artwork was. It was so amazing to see our guests interact with her and watch this beautiful painting come to life. The moment I first saw it during the reception, I burst into tears because it was just that amazing. Heather truly loves and cares about her work and her clients. I can’t recommend her enough!

owner_reply.text: Oh Ally!!! Thank you so so much!! Working your wedding was such a beautiful experience! You planned a gorgeous wedding and it was sooo much fun painting for your family and friends!! I hope you enjoy your painting everyday!!💗🌸💗
